BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me how fishery regulations aim to keep sustainable fish populations? ASSISTANT:

Fishery regulations aim to protect and sustain fish populations by setting limits on the catch of fish, establishing seasons and closures, and managing fishing gear and methods. Regulations also establish minimum size limits to protect young fish, and protect sensitive habitats by limiting or banning certain fishing activities in certain areas.
